description: Change a setting of a room the account owns or administers that only a script can change. hide_pings: true makes the apps show the room as its feed alone, with no Quick Pings, no Custom Ping and no Live update button; for a room people only read, such as a status or metrics feed. It hides the controls and refuses no send: Pings sent through the API, webhooks and triggers arrive as before. false shows them again. A change sends a background room refresh to room members' devices.

hide_pings.description: true hides the room's Quick Pings, Custom Ping and Live update controls in the apps; false shows them.

name: update_room_settings

result.description: Purpose-built PingRoom result with credential and account fields removed.

title: Update Room Settings
